scope: Optimized standalone Mac experiment on a bounded message with 50,000 empty formatting elements before meaningful content. Current mirrors the production tag-bound SwiftSoup read, stream uses system libxml2 SAX without a document tree, oracle uses the full pinned SwiftSoup text projection on this finite test fixture only. Comparison is the initial stream; compatibility adds HTML5 named-reference handling and body noscript text. Records preserve the actual extracted text and all timings. The normal native message renderer is separate.

extendedComparisons.description: System libxml2 streaming extractor versus the pinned SwiftSoup document text on identical finite fixtures, including meaningful content following a long sequence of empty formatting elements.
